import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', s=80, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI / Gender', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Distribution of Sleep Quality by Sleep Disorder
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Fill NaN values with 'None' for visualization
df_plot = df.copy()
df_plot['Sleep Disorder'] = df_plot['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
order = ['None', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Insomnia']
existing_order = [x for x in order if x in df_plot['Sleep Disorder'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df_plot, x='Sleep Disorder', y='Quality of Sleep', 
            palette='Set2', order=existing_order, ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Stress Level vs Physical Activity Level colored by Sleep Duration
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
                      c=df['Sleep Duration'], cmap='RdYlGn', s=60, alpha=0.7)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax3)
cbar.set_label('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (minutes/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity (colored by Sleep Duration)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 4: Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
occupation_stats = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).round(2)
occupation_stats = occupation_stats.sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=True)

x = range(len(occupation_stats))
width = 0.25

bars1 = ax4.barh([i - width for i in x], occupation_stats['Sleep Duration'], 
                  width, label='Sleep Duration (hrs)', color='steelblue', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax4.barh([i for i in x], occupation_stats['Quality of Sleep'], 
                  width, label='Sleep Quality (1-10)', color='seagreen', alpha=0.8)
bars3 = ax4.barh([i + width for i in x], occupation_stats['Stress Level'], 
                  width, label='Stress Level (1-10)', color='coral', alpha=0.8)

ax4.set_yticks(x)
ax4.set_yticklabels(occupation_stats.index, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('Average Value', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
